control.scope: Current chat workflow; no vendor patch, no permission bypass, no global guarantee for approval/transport delays or first initialization.

frozen_app_promise_test.conclusion: Promise deadline alone fails to bound the complete tool call

startup.measurement_scope: Six fresh business directories and three new identities; identical compiled Release UUID. Existing-user/public identity and cold-cache startup not tested.
startup.original_probe_limit: OnScreenOnly count cannot distinguish a nonexistent window from a created window outside the current screen/Space. This does not prove that the original window existed.
startup.new_probe: Passively records both all sizeable owned layer-0 windows and on-screen count, plus app active/hidden/finished-launching metadata; no interaction or activation.
startup.evidence_preservation: Unique per-case log/result/window sequence; reject rerun-overwrite; on a 20-second missing window save exact-process sample and hold it for diagnosis.
startup.termination_scope: Nine startup measurement processes stopped by exact SIGTERM; not nine normal-Quit acceptance cases.
limits: Original first-launch raw log/result was overwritten and no original sample exists; cause cannot be retroactively proven.
Cold-cache and public-identity runtime admission not tested.
New identity first launch timings are a separate category, not pooled to claim the previous resource gate passed.
